# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.

completion:
Use this document to understand the requirements listed in the Regulation of South African National Standard (SANS) 10259.1.
3. Determine any irregularities present in the test records.
4. Prepare supporting documentation:

   a. Repair work order.
   b. Electrical shock test graphs.
   c. Test report.

5. Complete the checklists:

   a. Test checklist.
   b. Test instrument checklist.

6. Compile a detailed report and attach all required documentation.
